right.raw_text: with a diagnosis of Type 2 diabetes (WHO criteria).

left.raw_text: Female patients must be postmenopausal or must have had a bilateral oophorectomy
or must have been surgically sterilized or hysterectomized at least 6 months prior to screening.
To be eligible patients must fulfill the following criteria: Patients on ongoing hypertensive therapy
must have a blood pressure ≥ 135/85 mm Hg but lower than 170/105 mm Hg at baseline (Day -1)

right.raw_text: AND patients must be on stable antihypertensive medications for at least 8 weeks prior to baseline (Day -1).

left.raw_text: Patients must be on stable hypoglycemic medications

right.raw_text: for at least 8 weeks prior to Visit 2 (Day -1).

left.raw_text: Patients must be willing and medically able to discontinue all Angiotensin-converting enzyme inhibitor (ACEI)

right.raw_text: and potassium sparing diuretic medications for the duration of the study.

left.raw_text: Oral body temperature within the range 35.0-37.5 °C
Able to provide written informed consent prior to study participation.
